data.why: The tool bundles its own 384-well demo dataset (12 siRNAs x 5 insulin doses x 2 conditions x 2 replicate plates) generated in-browser by the 'Load Template Data' button, so no external files are needed to exercise the full workflow.

goals: Merge plate-reader result files with well/plate metadata to build a single analysis-ready table
Visualize the merged data as a plate heatmap and grouped bar charts to spot spatial artifacts or outlier wells
Compute assay-window screening statistics (Z-score, SSMD, Z' factor, D-ratio) with outlier removal and multiple-testing correction to judge assay quality and hit calling
Fit dose-response curves (4PL) to estimate EC50 and run 2-way ANOVA with post-hoc tests across dose groups
Export merged data, statistics tables, and GraphPad Prism-ready XY/Column/Grouped tables for downstream reporting

review.summary: The tree describes the tool accurately as a plate-design + plate-reader merge, QC, screening-statistics and Prism-export pipeline, with well-labelled phases and tasks, and every screen I sampled supports its node. It needs small fixes before filing: check.json's screen paths don't resolve, the help phase should become a feature, two button-level tasks should be folded, and the multi-plate and all-pairs paths should be added as untested branches.
